article_text:
172. What does Mr. Hassan announce to the other writers?
(A)
The theme for a magazine issue
(B)
A change to a meeting agenda
(C)
Some feedback on a recent project
(D)
A positive development for their business
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“Lila Bernardi has agreed to film a "10 Questions for a Star" video for the magazine's Web site.”

Tin nhắn đầu tiên của Malik Hassan.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Lila Bernardi đã đồng ý quay video "10 câu hỏi dành cho một ngôi sao" cho trang web của tạp chí.

2

Paraphrase

celebrity video for the magazine's Web site = a positive development for their business. Nội dung có thể tăng nhận diện và hợp tác.

Chọn D — A positive development for their business.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Chủ đề số tạp chí tháng Ba chưa được công bố trong tin nhắn.

Paraphrase

Malik Hassan 10:00 A.M.: Good morning, everyone!

question: 176. What is the purpose of the information?
article_text:
176. What is the purpose of the information?
(A)
To publicize a local opportunity for mentorship
(B)
To seek donations for a charitable cause
(C)
To report on the success of an economic initiative
(D)
To recruit volunteer workers for an organization
Mục đích

DẪN CHỨNG

“The Staley Foundation is proud to support the growth of small businesses through AIM, its mentorship program for small business owners.”

Đoạn giới thiệu AIM ở đầu tài liệu.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Quỹ Staley tự hào hỗ trợ sự phát triển của các doanh nghiệp nhỏ thông qua AIM, chương trình cố vấn dành cho chủ doanh nghiệp nhỏ.

2

Paraphrase

support the growth of small businesses through a mentorship program = publicize a local opportunity for mentorship.

Chọn A — To publicize a local opportunity for mentorship.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

(B): Sai. Tài liệu không kêu gọi quyên góp cho quỹ.

(C): Sai. Không có báo cáo kết quả của một sáng kiến đã hoàn tất.

(D): Sai. Mentors là tình nguyện viên nhưng tài liệu chủ yếu hướng dẫn người đăng ký, không tuyển họ.

CẦN NHỚ

Mục đích tài liệu có thể suy ra từ động từ support, program và visit ... to learn how to apply. Dấu hiệu: applications, eligible, applicants và mentorship.

group_text:
Questions 176-180 refer to the following information and e-mail.
AIM The Staley Foundation The Staley Foundation is proud to support the growth of small businesses through AIM, its mentorship program for small business owners.
Mentees in the program are matched with volunteer mentors who then give ongoing expert advice at no cost.
This advice focuses on general matters such as business planning and human resources, though efforts are made to find mentors with insight into the mentee's specific field, whether it be technology or food service.
Mentees are also eligible to participate in AIM's frequent educational events and access its library of resources.
Applications to receive mentorship through AIM are accepted on a rolling basis.
Applicants must reside in the Hamrick City metropolitan area and have launched their business within the past 12 months.
Visit www.staleyfoundation.org/aim to learn how to apply.
About the Staley Foundation The Staley Foundation was established in honor of Rosaline Staley by her daughter, Emily Barrett.
Staley was a groundbreaking economist and author whose works are still frequently read in university classrooms today.
The foundation's mission is to improve the quality of life of Hamrick citizens through economic empowerment.
To:Aaliyah Williams From:Min-Woo Ma Subject:Re: Problem Date:April 4 Dear Ms. Williams, I am sorry to hear that you are having trouble arranging your first meeting with your AIM mentor.
Keep in mind that spring is a busy time for landscapers.
Still, one of our staff members will speak to Mr. Finn about the issue, and if necessary, we will assign you another, more responsive mentor.
Whatever happens, I hope you will attend a workshop on brand-building that we just scheduled for May 1.
The leader, Molly Tate, ran a successful interior design firm for years.
Of course, the workshop itself is intended for a general audience, but you could approach Ms. Tate afterwards about providing some extra guidance specific to your field.
Let me know if you are interested.
Sincerely,Min-Woo MaThe Staley Foundation

177. Who is Ms. Barrett?
(A)
The writer of a textbook
(B)
The founder of an organization
(C)
A previous participant in a program
(D)
An economics professor
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“The Staley Foundation was established in honor of Rosaline Staley by her daughter, Emily Barrett.”

Đoạn About the Staley Foundation.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Quỹ Staley được thành lập để tưởng nhớ Rosaline Staley bởi con gái bà, Emily Barrett.

2

Paraphrase

established ... by Emily Barrett = founder of an organization. Emily là người thành lập quỹ.

Chọn B — The founder of an organization.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Bài chỉ nói Rosaline là economist and author, không nói Emily viết textbook.

(C): Sai. Ms. Barrett không được mô tả là người tham gia AIM.

(D): Sai. Rosaline là economist, nhưng Emily không được gọi là giáo sư kinh tế.

CẦN NHỚ

Established by + tên người cho biết người sáng lập hoặc thành lập tổ chức. Dấu hiệu: foundation was established by, founded by hoặc created by.

178. What is one reason Mr. Ma sent the e-mail?
(A)
To ask for details about a problem
(B)
To give his opinion on some branding
(C)
To refuse a request for reassignment
(D)
To issue an invitation to an event
Mục đích

DẪN CHỨNG

“Whatever happens, I hope you will attend a workshop on brand-building that we just scheduled for May 1.”

Email trả lời của Min-Woo Ma, sau đề nghị xử lý mentor.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Dù chuyện gì xảy ra, tôi hy vọng chị sẽ tham dự một hội thảo về xây dựng thương hiệu vừa được lên lịch vào ngày 1 tháng 5.

2

Paraphrase

hope you will attend a workshop = issue an invitation to an event. Đây là một lý do riêng khiến ông Ma gửi email.

Chọn D — To issue an invitation to an event.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Ông Ma đã biết vấn đề từ email của Ms. Williams, không gửi email để hỏi chi tiết.

(B): Sai. Ông Ma không đưa ý kiến cá nhân về việc xây dựng thương hiệu.

(C): Sai. Ông Ma nói có thể đổi mentor nếu cần, không từ chối yêu cầu đó.

CẦN NHỚ

Invitation thường đi với hope you will attend, workshop và date. Dấu hiệu: attend, scheduled for và let me know if you are interested.

179. What can be concluded about Ms. Williams?
(A)
She inquired about Ms. Tate's qualifications.
(B)
She has been unable to reach Mr. Ma by phone.
(C)
She started a business less than a year ago.
(D)
She will have more free time next month.
Suy luận

DẪN CHỨNG

“Applicants must reside in the Hamrick City metropolitan area and have launched their business within the past 12 months.”

Đoạn nêu điều kiện đăng ký AIM.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Ứng viên phải cư trú trong khu vực đô thị Hamrick City và đã khởi nghiệp trong vòng 12 tháng qua.

2

Paraphrase

launched their business within the past 12 months = Ms. Williams started a business less than a year ago. Cô ấy đang gặp mentor AIM.

Chọn C — She started a business less than a year ago.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Không có câu nào nói Ms. Williams hỏi về bằng cấp của Ms. Tate.

(B): Sai. Email cho thấy Min-Woo đã trả lời cô ấy, không phải cô ấy không liên lạc được bằng điện thoại.

(D): Sai. Bài chỉ nói mùa xuân bận với landscapers, không nói tháng sau cô ấy rảnh hơn.

CẦN NHỚ

Suy luận phải nối điều kiện tham gia chương trình với việc nhân vật đang tham gia. Dấu hiệu: applicants must ... launched within the past 12 months.

180. In what industry does Ms. Williams most likely work?
(A)
Technology
(B)
Food service
(C)
Landscaping
(D)
Interior design
Suy luận

DẪN CHỨNG

“The leader, Molly Tate, ran a successful interior design firm for years.”

Đoạn giới thiệu người dẫn workshop brand-building.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Người dẫn chương trình, Molly Tate, đã điều hành một công ty thiết kế nội thất thành công trong nhiều năm.

2

Paraphrase

interior design firm + extra guidance specific to your field = Ms. Williams most likely works in interior design.

Chọn D — Interior design.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

(A)

They share the same average rating.
(D)
They have received the same number of reviews.

“Greenworld Cleaners ★★★★☆ 4.5 (18 reviews)”

Dòng đầu tiên trong danh sách kết quả Crowdview.

Dịch dẫn chứng

Barger Family Cleaners, 4,0 sao với 16 lượt đánh giá; dịch vụ đặc biệt gồm giặt khô và đồ vải gia dụng.

2

Paraphrase

household linens = a set of window curtains. Rèm cửa là đồ vải gia dụng.

Chọn B — Wash a set of window curtains.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Barger không ghi dịch vụ xử lý trong 24 giờ.

(C): Sai. Pickup/delivery chỉ có ở Greenworld, không có trong dòng Barger.

(D): Sai. Clothing alteration/repair chỉ được nêu cho Champion và Milburn.

CẦN NHỚ

Household linens là đồ vải dùng trong nhà như rèm hoặc khăn, khác với clothing. Dấu hiệu: special services liệt kê household linens.

183. What does Ms. Lim say about her dress?
(A)
Its color is the result of a special dyeing technique.
(B)
It has been stored in her closet for a long time.
(C)
Some of its original stitching was done by hand.
(D)
It used to belong to one of her relatives.
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“I recently inherited a beautiful ivory silk dress from my grandmother that had become yellowed with age in some areas and had a small tear in the skirt.”

Đoạn đầu bài review của Ms. Lim.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Gần đây tôi thừa hưởng một chiếc váy lụa màu ngà tuyệt đẹp từ bà của mình; một số chỗ đã ngả vàng theo thời gian và chân váy có một vết rách nhỏ.

2

Paraphrase

inherited ... from my grandmother = it used to belong to one of her relatives.

Chọn D — It used to belong to one of her relatives.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Màu ngà và việc bị ngả vàng không cho thấy kỹ thuật nhuộm đặc biệt.

(B): Sai. Bài nói váy bị cũ theo thời gian, không nói nó đã nằm trong tủ lâu.

(C): Sai. Không có thông tin về việc đường may ban đầu được làm thủ công.

CẦN NHỚ

Inherit something from a relative nghĩa là nhận lại vật thuộc về người thân sau này. Dấu hiệu: inherited from my grandmother.

184. How far from Ms. Lim's location is the business she chose?
(A)
0.8 miles
(B)
1.4 miles
(C)
3.9 miles
(D)
4.5 miles
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“455 First Street Lanham, OK Distance: 1.4 miles”

Dòng thông tin địa chỉ của Champion Cleaning.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

455 First Street, Lanham, Oklahoma; khoảng cách 1,4 dặm.

2

Paraphrase

Champion Cleaning + Distance: 1.4 miles = the business she chose was 1.4 miles away.

Chọn B — 1.4 miles.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. 0,8 dặm là khoảng cách của Greenworld Cleaners Lanham.

(C): Sai. 3,9 dặm là khoảng cách của Milburn Laundry Services.

(D): Sai. 4,5 dặm là khoảng cách của Greenworld Cleaners ở Embryville.

CẦN NHỚ

Khi hỏi khoảng cách, nối cửa hàng được chọn trong review với trường Distance của chính dòng đó. Dấu hiệu: Champion Cleaning và 1.4 miles.

185. According to the review, what disappointed Ms. Lim?
(A)
The prices that were charged for some services
(B)
The advice provided by an employee
(C)
The accuracy of a review on Crowdview
(D)
The persistence of a problem after a cleaning
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“My only complaint about Champion Cleaning is that their excellent work comes at a high price.”

Câu gần cuối review.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Phàn nàn duy nhất của tôi về Champion Cleaning là công việc tuyệt vời của họ có giá cao.

2

Paraphrase

high price = the prices charged for some services disappointed her.

Chọn A — The prices that were charged for some services.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

(B): Sai. Nhân viên đã giải thích cách bảo quản váy, và cô ấy không phàn nàn về lời khuyên đó.

(C): Sai. Cô ấy nói một review khác hữu ích, không thất vọng về độ chính xác của review.

(D): Sai. Champion đã loại bỏ vết ố và sửa rách thành công, không còn vấn đề sau khi giặt.

CẦN NHỚ

Complaint about a high price là phàn nàn về chi phí, không phải chất lượng kết quả. Dấu hiệu: high price, expensive hoặc not willing to pay that much.

question: 186. According to the article, what is true about the planned improvements?
article_text:
186. According to the article, what is true about the planned improvements?
(A)
They are part of a pilot program.
(B)
They include repairs of some damage.
(C)
They will relieve traffic congestion.
(D)
They are required by new safety laws.
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“"Separate turn lanes will allow traffic to flow smoothly instead of building up behind cars that are waiting to make a turn," explained Rod Thornton, the department's director.”

Đoạn giữa bài báo, sau mô tả làn rẽ và đèn giao thông.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Ông Rod Thornton giải thích rằng các làn rẽ riêng sẽ giúp giao thông lưu thông trôi chảy thay vì ùn lại phía sau những xe đang chờ rẽ.

2

Paraphrase

traffic to flow smoothly instead of building up = relieve traffic congestion.

Chọn C — They will relieve traffic congestion.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Bài không gọi dự án là chương trình thử nghiệm.

(B): Sai. Không mô tả sửa chữa hư hỏng; dự án chủ yếu mở rộng và tổ chức lại giao lộ.

(D): Sai. Không có luật an toàn mới nào được nêu là nguyên nhân bắt buộc.

CẦN NHỚ

Flow smoothly và building up behind cars là cách diễn đạt trực tiếp về ùn tắc. Dấu hiệu: traffic, rush hour, turn lanes và delays.

prompt: Questions 186-190 refer to the following article, schedule, and e-mail.
group_text:
Questions 186-190 refer to the following article, schedule, and e-mail.
Improvements to Bellamy Parkway Scheduled (March 10)—Over the next several weeks, the Grovert Department of Transportation will oversee improvements to some of Bellamy Parkway's major intersections between Colwell Street and Hines Creek Drive.
The parkway will be widened around each intersection to create turn lanes for both left and right turns, and dedicated stoplights will be added to control the left-turn lanes.
"Separate turn lanes will allow traffic to flow smoothly instead of building up behind cars that are waiting to make a turn," explained Rod Thornton, the department's director.
"As the city's population has grown, this has become a problem, particularly during rush hour and near Rock Hills Elementary School." Frustrated Grovert voters approved a short-term increase in the city's property taxes to pay for the $1.8 million project.
During the improvements to each intersection, two of the parkway's four lanes will be closed to traffic to provide space for work crews and equipment.
Drivers who take Bellamy Parkway frequently should visit the Department of Transportation's Web site to check the roadwork schedule.
BELLAMY PARKWAY IMPROVEMENTS SCHEDULE March 14–March 25: Colwell Street intersection March 28–April 8: Hines Creek Drive intersection April 11–April 22: Newton Street intersection April 25–May 6: Silva Boulevard intersection Delays or other changes to this schedule will be announced on the homepage of the Department of Transportation's Web site.
To:Lillian Magano From:Yuriko Fujita Date:April 7 Subject:Roadwork reminder Hi Lillian, I was just looking over the school calendar and noticed that the roadwork on the turnoff to our street starts next Monday, the eleventh.
Before you leave work today, could you send out an additional reminder to parents about it?
Since it will be taking place so close by, I think it will cause more inconvenience to the school than the upgrades to other sections of the parkway have.
We should warn the parents that school buses may be a little behind schedule in the afternoons, and that those who drive may see delays during pick-up and drop-off.
Thanks,Yuriko FujitaVice Principal

They are required by new safety laws.

CẦN NHỚ

Flow smoothly và building up behind cars là cách diễn đạt trực tiếp về ùn tắc. Dấu hiệu: traffic, rush hour, turn lanes và delays.

187. What does the article mention about the cost of the project?
(A)
It will be covered by tax revenue.
(B)
It will be higher than initially expected.
(C)
It has not been made public.
(D)
It is reasonable.
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“Frustrated Grovert voters approved a short-term increase in the city's property taxes to pay for the $1.8 million project.”

Đoạn nói về nguồn kinh phí dự án.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Các cử tri Grovert thất vọng đã thông qua việc tăng thuế bất động sản ngắn hạn của thành phố để chi trả cho dự án trị giá 1,8 triệu đô-la.

2

Paraphrase

increase in property taxes to pay for the project = it will be covered by tax revenue.

Chọn A — It will be covered by tax revenue.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

(B): Sai. Bài chỉ nêu số tiền dự án, không nói chi phí cao hơn dự kiến.

(C): Sai. Chi phí 1,8 triệu đô-la đã được công bố trong bài.

(D): Sai. Bài không đánh giá chi phí là reasonable; chỉ nói nguồn tiền thuế.

CẦN NHỚ

To pay for a project bằng property taxes cho biết nguồn tài trợ là thuế. Dấu hiệu: approved an increase in taxes to pay for.

188. What will happen on March 14?
(A)
Citizens will vote on a proposal.
(B)
Some lanes of a street will be closed.
(C)
Revisions to a schedule will be announced.
(D)
A city department will host an information session.
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“March 14–March 25: Colwell Street intersection”

Dòng đầu tiên của bảng lịch roadwork.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Ngày 14–25 tháng 3: giao lộ Colwell Street.

2

Paraphrase

March 14 begins work at an intersection, during which two lanes will be closed = some lanes of a street will be closed.

Chọn B — Some lanes of a street will be closed.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Bài không nói ngày 14 có bỏ phiếu của người dân.

(C): Sai. Thông báo thay đổi lịch sẽ xuất hiện trên homepage khi có delay, không phải việc chắc chắn ngày 14.

(D): Sai. Không có buổi cung cấp thông tin nào do sở tổ chức ngày này.

CẦN NHỚ

Kết hợp dòng lịch với quy định two of four lanes will be closed during improvements. Dấu hiệu: ngày bắt đầu một intersection project báo việc đóng làn.

189. Why did Ms. Fujita write the e-mail?
(A)
To explain the meaning of a calendar entry
(B)
To list some transportation alternatives
(C)
To assign a communication task
(D)
To suggest delaying a pick-up time
Mục đích

DẪN CHỨNG

“Before you leave work today, could you send out an additional reminder to parents about it?”

Đoạn đầu email của phó hiệu trưởng.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Trước khi rời công việc hôm nay, bạn có thể gửi thêm một lời nhắc cho phụ huynh về việc đó không?

2

Paraphrase

send out an additional reminder = assign a communication task. Fujita giao cho Magano việc gửi thông báo.

Chọn C — To assign a communication task.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Email không giải thích nghĩa của mục trong lịch trường.

(B): Sai. Không liệt kê phương án di chuyển thay thế.

(D): Sai. Email cảnh báo xe buýt trễ, không đề xuất dời giờ đón.

CẦN NHỚ

Purpose của email công việc thường thể hiện bằng could you + động từ yêu cầu. Dấu hiệu: send out, reminder và before you leave work.

190. What is implied about Ms. Magano?
(A)
She subscribed to a mailing list.
(B)
She will meet with Ms. Fujita next week.
(C)
Her child attends elementary school.
(D)
Her workplace is on Newton Street.
Suy luận

DẪN CHỨNG

“April 11–April 22: Newton Street intersection”

Dòng lịch tương ứng với ngày mà email nói roadwork bắt đầu.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Ngày 11–22 tháng 4: giao lộ Newton Street.

2

Paraphrase

next Monday, the eleventh + Newton Street intersection = the turnoff to their street is near Ms. Magano's workplace.

Chọn D — Her workplace is on Newton Street.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Không có dấu hiệu cô ấy đăng ký mailing list.

(B): Sai. Không có kế hoạch gặp trực tiếp Fujita vào tuần sau.

(C): Sai. Cô ấy là người nhận email, nhưng bài không nói con cô ấy học trường tiểu học.

CẦN NHỚ

Suy luận địa điểm cần ghép mốc ngày trong email với dòng tương ứng trong lịch. Dấu hiệu: the eleventh khớp Newton Street intersection và our street.

prompt: Questions 186-190 refer to the following article, schedule, and e-mail.

Questions 186-190 refer to the following article, schedule, and e-mail.
Improvements to Bellamy Parkway Scheduled (March 10)—Over the next several weeks, the Grovert Department of Transportation will oversee improvements to some of Bellamy Parkway's major intersections between Colwell Street and Hines Creek Drive.
The parkway will be widened around each intersection to create turn lanes for both left and right turns, and dedicated stoplights will be added to control the left-turn lanes.
"Separate turn lanes will allow traffic to flow smoothly instead of building up behind cars that are waiting to make a turn," explained Rod Thornton, the department's director.
"As the city's population has grown, this has become a problem, particularly during rush hour and near Rock Hills Elementary School." Frustrated Grovert voters approved a short-term increase in the city's property taxes to pay for the $1.8 million project.
During the improvements to each intersection, two of the parkway's four lanes will be closed to traffic to provide space for work crews and equipment.
Drivers who take Bellamy Parkway frequently should visit the Department of Transportation's Web site to check the roadwork schedule.
BELLAMY PARKWAY IMPROVEMENTS SCHEDULE March 14–March 25: Colwell Street intersection March 28–April 8: Hines Creek Drive intersection April 11–April 22: Newton Street intersection April 25–May 6: Silva Boulevard intersection Delays or other changes to this schedule will be announced on the homepage of the Department of Transportation's Web site.
To:Lillian Magano From:Yuriko Fujita Date:April 7 Subject:Roadwork reminder Hi Lillian, I was just looking over the school calendar and noticed that the roadwork on the turnoff to our street starts next Monday, the eleventh.
Before you leave work today, could you send out an additional reminder to parents about it?
Since it will be taking place so close by, I think it will cause more inconvenience to the school than the upgrades to other sections of the parkway have.
We should warn the parents that school buses may be a little behind schedule in the afternoons, and that those who drive may see delays during pick-up and drop-off.
Thanks,Yuriko FujitaVice Principal

They are part of a pilot program.

They will relieve traffic congestion.

They are required by new safety laws.

“"Separate turn lanes will allow traffic to flow smoothly instead of building up behind cars that are waiting to make a turn," explained Rod Thornton, the department's director.”

group_text:
Questions 186-190 refer to the following article, schedule, and e-mail.
Improvements to Bellamy Parkway Scheduled (March 10)—Over the next several weeks, the Grovert Department of Transportation will oversee improvements to some of Bellamy Parkway's major intersections between Colwell Street and Hines Creek Drive.
The parkway will be widened around each intersection to create turn lanes for both left and right turns, and dedicated stoplights will be added to control the left-turn lanes.
"Separate turn lanes will allow traffic to flow smoothly instead of building up behind cars that are waiting to make a turn," explained Rod Thornton, the department's director.
"As the city's population has grown, this has become a problem, particularly during rush hour and near Rock Hills Elementary School." Frustrated Grovert voters approved a short-term increase in the city's property taxes to pay for the $1.8 million project.
During the improvements to each intersection, two of the parkway's four lanes will be closed to traffic to provide space for work crews and equipment.
Drivers who take Bellamy Parkway frequently should visit the Department of Transportation's Web site to check the roadwork schedule.
BELLAMY PARKWAY IMPROVEMENTS SCHEDULE March 14–March 25: Colwell Street intersection March 28–April 8: Hines Creek Drive intersection April 11–April 22: Newton Street intersection April 25–May 6: Silva Boulevard intersection Delays or other changes to this schedule will be announced on the homepage of the Department of Transportation's Web site.
To:Lillian Magano From:Yuriko Fujita Date:April 7 Subject:Roadwork reminder Hi Lillian, I was just looking over the school calendar and noticed that the roadwork on the turnoff to our street starts next Monday, the eleventh.
Before you leave work today, could you send out an additional reminder to parents about it?
Since it will be taking place so close by, I think it will cause more inconvenience to the school than the upgrades to other sections of the parkway have.
We should warn the parents that school buses may be a little behind schedule in the afternoons, and that those who drive may see delays during pick-up and drop-off.
Thanks,Yuriko FujitaVice Principal

The Egmont Situated in Wellington's Central Business District, The Egmont is one of the city's most popular venues for private celebrations, corporate meetings, fund-raisers, and more.
Its convenient location is just a short walk away from numerous hotels, several bus stops, and a train station.
The Egmont offers two spacious multi-purpose event rooms.
The Manuka Room is best for groups of between 100 and 200, while our grandest space, the Kauri Room, can hold up to 300 guests comfortably.
We also have two dedicated conference rooms, the Rata Room and the Pikao Room, which have maximum capacities of 35 and 70 people, respectively.
State-of-the-art projectors, speakers, and other multimedia equipment are available for all of our rooms, supported by convenient in-house technical assistance.
In addition, The Egmont's catering service can make delicious, custom fare for a variety of situations, from light refreshments to multiple-course dinners.
First-time clients who reserve rooms for certain days and times are eligible for a 10% discount.
Visit www.theegmont.co.nz for details.
To:Aaron Jones From:Ruth Henare Date:12 October Subject:Awards dinner venue Hi Aaron, This morning I called The Egmont about hosting our annual awards dinner.
They do have the space and catering capacity to accommodate our entire guest list, which has grown beyond 200 people.
However, the room we'd need is already booked for every Saturday evening in November, so 11 November is no longer an option.
That Sunday, 12 November, is open, though, as is Friday, 17 November.
Also, Thursday, 16 November is available at a discounted rate.
I think we should take it.
Our attendees will understand the date change if we explain that our original venue shut down unexpectedly.
I hope you'll let me know your decision soon, as all of these dates are approaching quickly and there are many preparations still to be made.

With our budget in mind, I've decided that I'd like you to make the reservation for the discounted date.
Thank you.
Aaron JonesPresident, Wellington Commerce Council

Its convenient location is just a short walk away from numerous hotels, several bus stops, and a train station.
The Egmont offers two spacious multi-purpose event rooms.
The Manuka Room is best for groups of between 100 and 200, while our grandest space, the Kauri Room, can hold up to 300 guests comfortably.
We also have two dedicated conference rooms, the Rata Room and the Pikao Room, which have maximum capacities of 35 and 70 people, respectively.
State-of-the-art projectors, speakers, and other multimedia equipment are available for all of our rooms, supported by convenient in-house technical assistance.
In addition, The Egmont's catering service can make delicious, custom fare for a variety of situations, from light refreshments to multiple-course dinners.
First-time clients who reserve rooms for certain days and times are eligible for a 10% discount.
Visit www.theegmont.co.nz for details.

Thank you.

prompt: Questions 191-195 refer to the following brochure and e-mails.
group_text:
Questions 191-195 refer to the following brochure and e-mails.
The Egmont Situated in Wellington's Central Business District, The Egmont is one of the city's most popular venues for private celebrations, corporate meetings, fund-raisers, and more.
Its convenient location is just a short walk away from numerous hotels, several bus stops, and a train station.
The Egmont offers two spacious multi-purpose event rooms.
The Manuka Room is best for groups of between 100 and 200, while our grandest space, the Kauri Room, can hold up to 300 guests comfortably.
We also have two dedicated conference rooms, the Rata Room and the Pikao Room, which have maximum capacities of 35 and 70 people, respectively.
State-of-the-art projectors, speakers, and other multimedia equipment are available for all of our rooms, supported by convenient in-house technical assistance.
In addition, The Egmont's catering service can make delicious, custom fare for a variety of situations, from light refreshments to multiple-course dinners.
First-time clients who reserve rooms for certain days and times are eligible for a 10% discount.
Visit www.theegmont.co.nz for details.
To:Aaron Jones From:Ruth Henare Date:12 October Subject:Awards dinner venue Hi Aaron, This morning I called The Egmont about hosting our annual awards dinner.
They do have the space and catering capacity to accommodate our entire guest list, which has grown beyond 200 people.
However, the room we'd need is already booked for every Saturday evening in November, so 11 November is no longer an option.
That Sunday, 12 November, is open, though, as is Friday, 17 November.
Also, Thursday, 16 November is available at a discounted rate.
I think we should take it.
Our attendees will understand the date change if we explain that our original venue shut down unexpectedly.
I hope you'll let me know your decision soon, as all of these dates are approaching quickly and there are many preparations still to be made.
Thanks,Ruth To:Ruth Henare From:Aaron Jones Date:12 October Subject:Awards dinner venue Hi Ruth, I agree with you that The Egmont is a good choice.
With our budget in mind, I've decided that I'd like you to make the reservation for the discounted date.
Thank you.
Aaron JonesPresident, Wellington Commerce Council
Question
191. What does the brochure suggest about The Egmont?
(A)
It is a short train ride from Wellington.
(B)
Its staff includes an audiovisual technician.
(C)
It recently added a second restaurant.
(D)
It is the site of a large yearly fund-raiser.
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“State-of-the-art projectors, speakers, and other multimedia equipment are available for all of our rooms, supported by convenient in-house technical assistance.”

Đoạn mô tả tiện nghi kỹ thuật của venue.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Máy chiếu, loa và thiết bị đa phương tiện hiện đại có ở tất cả các phòng, được hỗ trợ bởi dịch vụ kỹ thuật tại chỗ.

2

Paraphrase

in-house technical assistance = staff includes an audiovisual technician.

Chọn B — Its staff includes an audiovisual technician.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Bài chỉ nói venue cách nhà ga một quãng đi bộ ngắn, không nói đi tàu ngắn.

(C): Sai. Không có nhà hàng thứ hai nào được nhắc tới.

(D): Sai. The Egmont là venue tổ chức fund-raisers, không phải địa điểm của một sự kiện thường niên cụ thể.

CẦN NHỚ

Multimedia equipment và in-house technical assistance cho thấy có nhân sự hỗ trợ audiovisual. Dấu hiệu: projectors, speakers, technical assistance.

192. What does Ms. Henare indicate about the awards dinner?
(A)
It will feature a buffet meal.
(B)
It will honor a hotel manager.
(C)
She will be unable to attend it.
(D)
She is seeking a new location for it.
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“This morning I called The Egmont about hosting our annual awards dinner.”

Câu đầu email của Ruth Henare.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Sáng nay tôi đã gọi The Egmont về việc tổ chức tiệc trao giải thường niên của chúng ta.

2

Paraphrase

about hosting our annual awards dinner + original venue shut down = she is seeking a new location.

Chọn D — She is seeking a new location for it.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Bài không nói tiệc sẽ có buffet; chỉ nói venue có catering capacity.

(B): Sai. Không có thông tin tiệc vinh danh một quản lý khách sạn.

(C): Sai. Ruth đang trao đổi và đề xuất ngày, không nói cô ấy không thể tham dự.

CẦN NHỚ

Khi địa điểm cũ shut down unexpectedly, việc gọi venue mới là tìm địa điểm thay thế. Dấu hiệu: hosting, original venue và dates available.

193. Where will the organization most likely hold its awards dinner?
(A)
In the Manuka Room
(B)
In the Kauri Room
(C)
In the Rata Room
(D)
In the Pikao Room
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“our grandest space, the Kauri Room, can hold up to 300 guests comfortably.”

Đoạn giới thiệu sức chứa các phòng.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Không gian lớn nhất của chúng tôi, phòng Kauri, có thể chứa thoải mái tới 300 khách.

2

Paraphrase

guest list has grown beyond 200 + Kauri holds up to 300 = the Kauri Room.

Chọn B — In the Kauri Room.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Manuka chỉ phù hợp nhóm từ 100 đến 200, trong khi danh sách đã vượt 200.

(C): Sai. Rata chỉ chứa tối đa 35 người.

(D): Sai. Pikao chỉ chứa tối đa 70 người.

CẦN NHỚ

Chọn phòng dựa vào sức chứa lớn hơn số khách, không chỉ dựa vào tên phòng. Dấu hiệu: beyond 200 và can hold up to 300.

194. Why is Ms. Henare concerned?
(A)
Many people have declined an invitation.
(B)
There is not much time to prepare for an event.
(C)
A catering service is more expensive than expected.
(D)
She has never seen a venue in person.
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“I hope you'll let me know your decision soon, as all of these dates are approaching quickly and there are many preparations still to be made.”

Đoạn cuối email của Ruth.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Tôi hy vọng anh sẽ sớm cho tôi biết quyết định vì tất cả những ngày này đang đến gần và vẫn còn nhiều việc chuẩn bị phải làm.

2

Paraphrase

dates approaching quickly + many preparations = there is not much time to prepare.

Chọn B — There is not much time to prepare for an event.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Bài không nói nhiều người đã từ chối lời mời.

(C): Sai. Lo ngại là thời gian chuẩn bị, không phải giá catering.

(D): Sai. Ruth gọi điện cho venue nhưng không nói cô chưa từng nhìn thấy venue.

CẦN NHỚ

Cụm dates approaching quickly và preparations still to be made là dấu hiệu thiếu thời gian chuẩn bị. Dấu hiệu: soon, approaching và preparations.

195. On which date will the Wellington Commerce Council's awards dinner most likely take place?
(A)
November 11
(B)
November 12
(C)
November 16
(D)
November 17
Tìm chi tiết

DẪN CHỨNG

“With our budget in mind, I've decided that I'd like you to make the reservation for the discounted date.”

Email trả lời của Aaron Jones.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Với ngân sách của chúng ta, tôi đã quyết định muốn chị đặt chỗ vào ngày được giảm giá.

2

Paraphrase

discounted date = Thursday, 16 November. Aaron chọn ngày có discounted rate.

Chọn C — November 16.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. 11 November đã kín vào mọi tối thứ Bảy trong tháng 11.

(B): Sai. 12 November có sẵn nhưng không phải ngày được giảm giá.

(D): Sai. 17 November có sẵn nhưng email không gọi đó là ngày discounted.

CẦN NHỚ

Khi một email nói discounted date, quay lại đoạn trước để tìm ngày gắn với discounted rate. Dấu hiệu: available at a discounted rate và budget.

question: 196. What is the purpose of the first e-mail?
article_text:
196. What is the purpose of the first e-mail?
(A)
To issue invitations to a demonstration
(B)
To explain the reasons for planned updates
(C)
To solicit suggestions for potential services
(D)
To recruit a group of product testers
Mục đích

DẪN CHỨNG

“you and your staff are invited to participate in beta testing of Slide Ace 2.3.”

Đoạn đầu email đầu tiên của Slide Ace.

Xem trong bài

SUY LUẬN

1

Dịch dẫn chứng

Anh và nhân viên được mời tham gia thử nghiệm beta Slide Ace 2.3.

2

Paraphrase

invited to participate in beta testing = recruit a group of product testers.

Chọn D — To recruit a group of product testers.

BẪY ĐÁP ÁN

Bạn chọn (A): Sai. Email mời thử nghiệm phiên bản mới, không mời tham dự một buổi trình diễn.

(B): Sai. Các tính năng mới được mô tả, nhưng email không giải thích lý do cập nhật.

(C): Sai. Người nhận được mời thử sản phẩm, không được hỏi đề xuất dịch vụ tương lai.

CẦN NHỚ

Beta testing là thử nghiệm sản phẩm trước khi phát hành rộng rãi. Dấu hiệu: invited to participate, new version và release widely.

prompt: Questions 196-200 refer to the following e-mails and survey excerpt.
group_text:
Questions 196-200 refer to the following e-mails and survey excerpt.
E-Mail message
From:	Slide Ace <contact@slideace.com>
To:	Roy Thornton <roy.thornton@gannitt.com>
Subject:	Opportunity
Date:	July 10

Dear Mr. Thornton,

As valued users of Slide Ace 2.2, you and your staff are invited to participate in beta testing of Slide Ace 2.3. This new version of Slide Ace, which we hope to release widely by the end of year, features ReadyGo, a library of sophisticated slide templates created by design professionals. Other major changes include dashboard reporting of helpful statistics on your team's use of stored slides and a brand management tool that enables easy updating of your logo and preferred color schemes and fonts across all of your presentations.

Slide Ace 2.3 can be downloaded here. We hope you will agree to be part of this exciting step forward for the platform.

Sincerely,

Slide Ace

User: Roy Thornton

This is the final page of the survey. Please add any comments here that could help explain your answers to previous questions.

I gave the dashboard a "2" because it feels too cluttered. Perhaps you could make it possible to customize the types of data that are shown on the dashboard.

The new brand management tool is a great idea that will be really helpful for our company as a quickly-evolving startup. The only reason I didn't give it a perfect score is that Slide Ace crashed the first time I tried it.

Thank you for your participation!

E-Mail message
From:	Miriam Cassidy <miriam.cassidy@slideace.com>
To:	Nicole Liu <nicole.liu@slideace.com>
Subject:	News
Date:	August 2
Attachment:	📎 Aug 2 Feedback

Subject:	Opportunity
Date:	July 10

Dear Mr. Thornton,

As valued users of Slide Ace 2.2, you and your staff are invited to participate in beta testing of Slide Ace 2.3. This new version of Slide Ace, which we hope to release widely by the end of year, features ReadyGo, a library of sophisticated slide templates created by design professionals. Other major changes include dashboard reporting of helpful statistics on your team's use of stored slides and a brand management tool that enables easy updating of your logo and preferred color schemes and fonts across all of your presentations.

Slide Ace 2.3 can be downloaded here. We hope you will agree to be part of this exciting step forward for the platform.

Sincerely,

Slide Ace

User: Roy Thornton

This is the final page of the survey. Please add any comments here that could help explain your answers to previous questions.

I gave the dashboard a "2" because it feels too cluttered. Perhaps you could make it possible to customize the types of data that are shown on the dashboard.

The new brand management tool is a great idea that will be really helpful for our company as a quickly-evolving startup. The only reason I didn't give it a perfect score is that Slide Ace crashed the first time I tried it.

Thank you for your participation!

Miriam
